headline: 50% Cut in November Income Tax Withholding Excludes Higher Earners
summary: The government has confirmed a 50% cut in income tax withholding on November salaries and Christmas bonuses. The measure covers most workers and pensioners, excluding only very high monthly incomes.
why: Income tax withholding determines how much tax is deducted from pay each month. Changes shift household disposable income and can affect consumer spending.

original_headline: Redução de 50% no IRS em novembro exclui quem tem rendimentos mais altos
